name: SillyTavern
summary: Local-first LLM roleplay frontend for power users: total control over prompts, samplers, V2 character cards and lorebooks, plus any backend (local vLLM/Kobold/Oobabooga or OpenRouter/DeepSeek). Zero platform censorship because there is no platform server.
ranking_rationale: Fan-scout records heavy community support (r/SillyTavernAI power-user threads 2025-2026 plus Hacker News debate, quotes on file): extensibility and total backend freedom as the draw, learning curve and API bills as the cost. Scam-hunt has no record for it - recorded as an absence, not a clearance. Ranked top for NSFW freedom, testability (free software) and privacy; pricing is not its product.

pricing.notes: Pricing could not be verified at check time; no third-party figure copied per desk rules.
